name: WNBA_R3A_SIGNAL_CUSTODY_AUDIT_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Determine which preregistered R3 signal families are exactly reconstructible from frozen historical WNBA assets before any feature-combination performance testing.

source_custody.download_rule: Download each exact SportsDataverse release asset by frozen asset_id and require exact byte size and SHA-256 before schema/coverage inspection.

FTr.consistency_note: Matches the current WNBA shot-profile implementation's FTA/FGA convention.

opponent_allowed_profiles.formula: Use the paired opponent row from finalized prior games and the same frozen formulas; no target-game values.

coverage_rule.exact_historical_reconstructible: All required fields exist with finite/valid values at materially complete coverage on two-sided regular-season rows, and the target feature can be generated using only finalized prior official dates.
coverage_rule.partial_or_proxy_only: A required exact field or denominator is absent/incomplete but a non-equivalent proxy could be computed. Proxies are not silently promoted to the exact signal.
coverage_rule.prospective_only: The implementation/source is current-state only and no timestamped historical pregame custody is certified.
coverage_rule.blocked: No defensible historical or prospective custody currently exists for the preregistered signal.

AVAILABILITY_STAR_POWER.reason: Current ESPN injury implementation is a live scrape and computes days-out relative to current time; no timestamped 2021-2025 pregame injury archive is certified.

MANUAL_AVAILABILITY_ADJUSTMENT.reason: No historical timestamped manual-adjustment ledger is certified.

H2H_PREFIX.reason: Frozen schedule/team-game identity and finalized prior-game scores permit strict date-prefix reconstruction; target-date/same-date results remain excluded.

FATIGUE_CALENDAR.reason: Days rest, B2B, 3-in-5 and 4-in-7 are deterministic from frozen prior schedule chronology.

TRAVEL_DEPLOYED_STATIC_SEMANTICS.reason: R1A4D certified exact deployed franchise-coordinate Haversine semantics; this is not a claim of physical trip truth.

TRAVEL_ACTUAL_LOCATION_SEQUENCE.reason: R3 permits it only if actual prior-to-target location/venue coordinate custody is independently certified.

hard_fail_conditions: Any frozen asset id, byte size or SHA-256 mismatch.
Any schema-driven change to a frozen feature formula during the audit.
Any use of sportsbook data to classify sporting-signal custody.
Any claim that current injury status is historical pregame truth.
